assignments.reason: Time-bound mitzvot (mitzvot zemaniyot) are the practical vehicle for elevating time into above-time. The source text states: 'vezeh bchinat mitzvot zemaniyot, kedei lizkot al yedei ha-mitzvot zemaniyot she-yitached ha-zman.' Their essential nature is the active practice of teshuvah — sanctifying bounded time to transcend it — which is the core identity of Package 1 (teshuvah and nullification of time).

assignments.node_id: שיתאחד הזמן ויעלה הזמן לבחינת למעלה מהזמן
assignments.reason: This node — 'that time unify and rise to above-time' — is a direct verbal expression of hitachdut hazman / bitul hazman, which is the central thesis of Package 1. Its essential nature is identical to the package's dominant concept: the unification/nullification of time through teshuvah.

Holiness of thought (kedushat ha-machshavah) is the essential means of teshuvah-repair. The text states: 'ikar tikun ha-teshuvah hu al yedei kedushat ha-machshavah she-mevareret u-metakenet kol ha-pegamim.' Its nature is purification and rectification — the inner mechanism of teshuvah itself. It belongs in Package 1 because its essential identity is the teshuvah process, not a separate domain.

assignments.node_id: זוכין לשמע הקול דקדשה ולהכניע הקול דסטרא אחרא
assignments.reason: This node — 'meriting to hear the holy voice and subduing the sitra achra's voice' — is essentially the attainment of the holy voice. Its core identity is the kol d'kedushah, the telos of the teaching. The subduing of the evil voice is the necessary complement of hearing the holy one: when the holy voice is heard, the evil voice is overcome. This is Package 3's domain — the holy voice and its triumph.

This node — 'hearing the holy voice' — is a direct expression of the kol d'kedushah. It is simply Package 3's core concept stated as an experiential attainment. Its essential nature is the holy voice itself.

assignments.node_id: זוכין לשמע קולו יתברך, הינו הקול דקדשה
assignments.reason: This node — 'meriting to hear His blessed voice, namely the holy voice' — explicitly identifies itself as kolo yitbarakh = ha-kol d'kedushah. The text says: 'al yedei teshuvah zokhin lishmo'a kolo yitbarakh, haynu ha-kol d'kedushah.' Its essential nature is identical to Package 3's dominant node (קולו יתברך).

assignments.node_id: להגביר הקול קול יעקב על הקול דסטרא־אחרא, שהוא בחינת עשו, שנאמר בו "וישא קולו", שהוא מתגבר להעלים, חס ושלום, הקול של יעקב, וצריכין להתגבר להכניע הקול של עשו
assignments.reason: This node describes the overpowering of Jacob's holy voice over Esav's evil voice. Its essential nature is the triumph of the kol d'kedushah — the holy voice prevailing. While it mentions Esav's voice as the opponent, the node's identity is the positive outcome: the holy voice dominates. The text frames this as the culmination of teshuvah: 'va-azai mitgaber ha-kol Yaakov al kol shel Esav.' This belongs in Package 3, the holy voice domain.
